DEFLA.operator: shared technical prefix / multiple physical operators

evidence.observation: DE*FLA EVSEs at Museum Würth are shown under physical operator Firmenladen GmbH; ad-hoc enabled but exact direct price not published.
Other DE*FLA EVSEs are shown under physical operator e-con AG; ad-hoc enabled but exact direct price not published.
A DE*FLA EVSE is represented through Hubject operator NL*LMS, reinforcing that DEFLA cannot be treated as a single tariff authority.

DEFLA.reason: Verified DE*FLA EVSEs map to different physical operators (including Firmenladen GmbH and e-con AG), while public station pages expose ad-hoc availability without a uniform exact price. A prefix-wide tariff would therefore be unsafe.
DEFLA.neededToComplete: Resolve every DEFLA EVSE to its physical CPO and retrieve the exact public direct/QR price from the physical operator or an official/public station-level feed.

DEBDO.operator: shared/externally operated BDO prefix; multiple station tariffs

evidence.observation: DE*BDO*E724242225*2 is shown with LichtBlick eMobility GmbH and an ad-hoc tariff of 0.79 EUR/kWh plus 1.99 EUR direct-pay fee and 0.099 EUR/min from 45 minutes, capped at 12 EUR.
DE*BDO*E237502750*1 is shown with LichtBlick eMobility GmbH and a different ad-hoc tariff: 0.5736 EUR/kWh plus 2.35 EUR direct-pay fee and 0.099 EUR/min after 60 minutes, capped at 12 EUR.
A DE*BDO station in Duderstadt reports a different station-level energy price and blocking fee, confirming site variability.

DEBDO.reason: Exact DEBDO prices demonstrably vary by station and include different fixed direct-pay and blocking components. Public data also identifies external physical operation. No single DEBDO tariff can be safely generalized.
DEBDO.neededToComplete: Harvest exact station/EVSE direct tariffs for all DEBDO EVSEs from Hubject/public checkout or equivalent verifiable station-level feeds, preserving fixed fees and blocking rules.

evidence.observation: SWM officially confirms ad-hoc direct payment by credit card at SWM stations and states that since 2026-07-01 costs depend on the selected tariff; the FAQ does not publish the exact ad-hoc matrix.
SWM publishes registered Flex tariff prices of 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.69 EUR/kWh DC/HPC on SWM stations, but these are card-product prices and are not automatically evidence of ad-hoc direct pricing.
DE*LIS EVSEs are verified at SWM sites; the ad-hoc price remains unknown on this public station page.

DELIS.reason: The operator and ad-hoc payment path are official and clear, but the current exact direct-payment tariff for every DELIS EVSE is not exposed in the retrieved official pages. Registered SWM card prices cannot be substituted for ad-hoc prices.
DELIS.neededToComplete: Resolve SWM's public credit-card/QR checkout or official AFIR/Mobilithek tariff feed and attach the exact current ad-hoc price and any time/blocking rule to every DELIS EVSE.

evidence.observation: APCOA officially confirms charging at German car parks and payment via APCOA app/RFID/roaming.
APCOA explicitly confirms ad-hoc charging by QR code at a DEACO-type charging location, but the electricity tariff itself is not published on the page.
DE*ACO EVSE IDs are verified at APCOA Charging sites; the direct ad-hoc price is reported unknown.

DEACO.reason: DEACO maps cleanly to APCOA, and official pages confirm QR ad-hoc charging, but current electricity prices are not exposed on the retrieved official location pages. Roaming tariff tables are not valid substitutes for APCOA direct pricing.
DEACO.neededToComplete: Resolve APCOA's public QR/ad-hoc checkout payload per EVSE/location and capture exact energy, time/blocking and any site-specific fees.
